summary: A Felucca-based firmware that turns the FM-1 into a chord machine: white keys play scale chords and strum them, black keys change the chord type.
features: Seven scale-degree chord keys plus a nine-key strumplate
Black keys add 7ths, 9ths, sus, dim and borrowed chords; slash bass
Strum, arp, drone, lead, 16-step chord sequencer and 4-layer looper
56 drum loops, 37 sounds, built-in effects and an ear trainer
MIDI in and out; settings kept after power-off
No Bluetooth or mic features; Felucca's synth is still underneath
